theorems.name: Submission.fiw_tl_tr_weighted_diff_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M₁ M₂ : Set (Eucl P)) (θ₁ θ₂ φ : Eucl P → ℝ) (x : Eucl P) (c ρ s K : ℝ), NullMeasurableSet M₁ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → NullMeasurableSet M₂ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → IntegrableOn θ₁ (M₁ ∩ closedBall x ρ) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → IntegrableOn θ₂ (M₂ ∩ closedBall x ρ) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → Continuous φ → (∀ z, ‖φ z‖ ≤ K) → (∀ z, z ∉ closedBall x s → φ z = 0) → s ≤ ρ → ‖(∫ z in M₂, φ z * θ₂ z ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) - c * ∫ z in M₁, φ z * θ₁ z ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))‖ₑ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal K * ∫⁻ z in closedBall x s, ‖M₂.indicator θ₂ z - c * M₁.indicator θ₁ z‖ₑ ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))
